content: Today's good vibes include NASA making progress towards the 2027 moon landing, Delta Goodrem heading to Eurovision to represent Australia, and a reminder from doctors to keep our little ones safe with seatbelts, even on short trips.

From marine life recovery in Pasir Panjang to A'ja Wilson's record-breaking WNBA win and the Matildas bringing home A-League glory, today's headlines are brimming with signs of resilience and celebratory achievements.

From Kansas City hosting the World Cup to old oil wells getting a clean energy makeover, and even Bill Ackman investing in Microsoft's AI future, today's filled with reasons to be optimistic!

Ending a very positive day, tensions ease with a truce between Lebanon and Israel, Runway is looking to give Google a run for its money in AI, and a father with no code built an AI baby tracker.
